# `aitbc operations agent message`

Send a message to an agent via a blockchain transaction.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations agent message [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent` | text | — | yes | Recipient agent address |
| `--message` | text | — | yes | Message content |
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name for signing |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations agent message --agent <agent> --message <message> --wallet <wallet>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc operations agent message --agent <agent> --message <message> --wallet <wallet> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
